trs.20: When the Occurrence occurs,
trs.85: When that which is coming arrives,
trs.22: When the Event inevitable cometh to pass,
trs.203: When the Event (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) befalls.

trs.20: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
trs.85: no one will be able to deny it has come,
trs.22: Then will no (soul) entertain falsehood concerning its coming.
trs.203: And there can be no denial of its befalling.

trs.20: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].<sup foot_note=197482>1</sup>
trs.85: bringing low and raising high.
trs.22: (Many) will it bring low; (many) will it exalt;
trs.203: Bringing low (some - those who will enter Hell) Exalting (others - those who will enter Paradise). [Tafsir Ibn Kathir]

trs.20: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
trs.85: When the earth is shaken violently
trs.22: When the earth shall be shaken to its depths,
trs.203: When the earth will be shaken with a terrible shake.

trs.20: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
trs.85: and the mountains are ground to powder
trs.22: And the mountains shall be crumbled to atoms,
trs.203: And the mountains will be powdered to dust,

trs.20: And become dust dispersing,
trs.85: and turn to scattered dust,
trs.22: Becoming dust scattered abroad,
trs.203: So that they will become floating dust particles.

trs.20: And you become [of] three kinds:
trs.85: then you will be sorted into three classes.
trs.22: And ye shall be sorted out into three classes.
trs.203: And you (all) will be in three groups.

trs.20: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?<sup foot_note=197483>1</sup>
trs.85: Those on the Right––what people they are!
trs.22: Then (there will be) the Companions of the Right Hand;- What will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
trs.203: So those on the Right Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Records in their right hands) - how (fortunate) will be those on the Right Hand! (As a respect for them, because they will enter Paradise).

trs.20: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?<sup foot_note=197484>1</sup>
trs.85: Those on the Left––what people they are!
trs.22: And the Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
trs.203: And those on the Left Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Record in their left hands) - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand! (As a disgrace for them, because they will enter Hell).

trs.20: And the forerunners, the forerunners<sup foot_note=197485>1</sup> -
trs.85: And those in front––ahead indeed!
trs.22: And those Foremost (in Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter).
trs.203: And those foremost [(in Islâmic Faith of Monotheism and in performing righteous deeds) in the life of this world on the very first call for to embrace Islâm] will be foremost (in Paradise).

trs.20: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]
trs.85: For these will be the ones brought nearest to God
trs.22: These will be those Nearest to Allah:
trs.203: These will be the nearest (to Allâh).

trs.20: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
trs.85: in Gardens of Bliss:
trs.22: In Gardens of Bliss:
trs.203: In the Gardens of Delight (Paradise).

trs.20: A [large] company of the former peoples
trs.85: many from the past
trs.22: A number of people from those of old,
trs.203: A multitude of those (foremost) will be from the first generations (who embraced Islâm).

trs.20: And a few of the later peoples,
trs.85: and a few from later generations.
trs.22: And a few from those of later times.
trs.203: And a few of those (foremost) will be from the later generations.

trs.20: On thrones woven [with ornament],
trs.85: On couches of well-woven cloth
trs.22: (They will be) on Thrones encrusted (with gold and precious stones),
trs.203: (They will be) on thrones woven with gold and precious stones.

trs.20: Reclining on them, facing each other.
trs.85: they will sit facing each other;
trs.22: Reclining on them, facing each other.
trs.203: Reclining thereon, face to face.

trs.20: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal.
trs.85: everlasting youths will go round among them
trs.22: Round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness),
trs.203: Immortal boys will go around them (serving),

trs.20: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
trs.85: with glasses, flagons, and cups of a pure drink
trs.22: With goblets, (shining) beakers, and cups (filled) out of clear-flowing fountains:
trs.203: With cups, and jugs, and a glass of flowing wine,

trs.20: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
trs.85: that causes no headache or intoxication;
trs.22: No after-ache will they receive therefrom, nor will they suffer intoxication:
trs.203: Wherefrom they will get neither any aching of the head, nor any intoxication.

trs.20: And fruit of what they select
trs.85: [there will be] any fruit they choose;
trs.22: And with fruits, any that they may select:
trs.203: And with fruit that they may choose.

trs.20: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
trs.85: the meat of any bird they like;
trs.22: And the flesh of fowls, any that they may desire.
trs.203: And with the flesh of fowls that they desire.

trs.20: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
trs.85: and beautiful companions
trs.22: And (there will be) Companions with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes,-
trs.203: And (there will be) Hûr (fair females) with wide, lovely eyes (as wives for "Al-Muttaqûn" - the pious - See V. 2:2),

trs.20: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
trs.85: like hidden pearls:
trs.22: Like unto Pearls well-guarded.
trs.203: Like unto preserved pearls.

trs.20: As reward for what they used to do.
trs.85: a reward for what they used to do.
trs.22: A Reward for the deeds of their past (life).
trs.203: A reward for what they used to do.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا

trs.20: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
trs.85: They will hear no idle or sinful talk there,
trs.22: Not frivolity will they hear therein, nor any taint of ill,-
trs.203: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk) will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech (like backbiting).

trs.20: Only a saying [of] peace, peace.
trs.85: only clean and wholesome speech.
trs.22: Only the saying, "Peace! Peace".
trs.203: But only the saying of: Salâm! Salâm! (greetings with peace)!<sup foot_note=154960>1</sup>

trs.20: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
trs.85: Those on the Right, what people they are!
trs.22: The Companions of the Right Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
trs.203: And those on the Right Hand - how (fortunate) will be those on the Right Hand?

trs.20: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed.
trs.85: They will dwell amid thornless lote trees
trs.22: (They will be) among Lote-trees without thorns,
trs.203: (They will be) among thornless lote-trees,

trs.20: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit].
trs.85: and clustered acacia
trs.22: Among Talh trees with flowers (or fruits) piled one above another,-
trs.203: And among Talh (banana-trees) with fruits piled one above another,

trs.20: And shade extended.
trs.85: with spreading shade,
trs.22: In shade long-extended,
trs.203: And in shade long-extended,

trs.20: And water poured out
trs.85: constantly flowing water,
trs.22: By water flowing constantly,
trs.203: And by water flowing constantly,

trs.20: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
trs.85: abundant fruits,
trs.22: And fruit in abundance.
trs.203: And fruit in plenty,

trs.20: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
trs.85: unfailing, unforbidden,
trs.22: Whose season is not limited, nor (supply) forbidden,
trs.203: Whose supply is not cut off (by change of season), nor are they out of reach,

trs.20: And [upon] beds raised high.
trs.85: with incomparable companions
trs.22: And on Thrones (of Dignity), raised high.
trs.203: And on couches or thrones, raised high.

trs.20: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation
trs.85: We have specially created––
trs.22: We have created (their Companions) of special creation.
trs.203: Verily, We have created them (maidens) of special creation.

trs.20: And made them virgins,
trs.85: virginal,
trs.22: And made them virgin - pure (and undefiled), -
trs.203: And made them virgins.

trs.20: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
trs.85: loving, of matching age––
trs.22: Beloved (by nature), equal in age,-
trs.203: Loving (their husbands only), (and) of equal age.

trs.20: For the companions of the right [who are]
trs.85: for those on the Right,
trs.22: For the Companions of the Right Hand.
trs.203: For those on the Right Hand.

trs.20: A company of the former peoples
trs.85: many from the past
trs.22: A (goodly) number from those of old,
trs.203: A multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the first generation (who embraced Islâm).

trs.20: And a company of the later peoples.
trs.85: and many from later generations.
trs.22: And a (goodly) number from those of later times.
trs.203: And a multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the later generations.

trs.20: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
trs.85: But those on the Left, what people they are!
trs.22: The Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
trs.203: And those on the Left Hand - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand?

trs.20: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
trs.85: They will dwell amid scorching wind and scalding water
trs.22: (They will be) in the midst of a Fierce Blast of Fire and in Boiling Water,
trs.203: In fierce hot wind and boiling water,

trs.20: And a shade of black smoke,
trs.85: in the shadow of black smoke,
trs.22: And in the shades of Black Smoke:
trs.203: And shadow of black smoke,

trs.20: Neither cool nor beneficial.
trs.85: neither cool nor refreshing.
trs.22: Nothing (will there be) to refresh, nor to please:
trs.203: (That shadow) neither cool, nor (even) pleasant,

trs.20: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
trs.85: Before, they overindulged in luxury
trs.22: For that they were wont to be indulged, before that, in wealth (and luxury),
trs.203: Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,

trs.20: And they used to persist in the great violation,<sup foot_note=197486>1</sup>
trs.85: and persisted in great sin,
trs.22: And persisted obstinately in wickedness supreme!
trs.203: And were persisting in great sin (joining partners in worship along with Allâh, committing murder and other crimes)<sup foot_note=154961>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

trs.20: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
trs.85: always saying, ‘What? When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then be raised up?
trs.22: And they used to say, "What! when we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be raised up again?-
trs.203: And they used to say: "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected?

trs.20: And our forefathers [as well]?"
trs.85: And our earliest forefathers too?’
trs.22: "(We) and our fathers of old?"
trs.203: "And also our forefathers?"

trs.20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, the former and later peoples
trs.85: Say [Prophet], ‘The earliest and latest generations
trs.22: Say: "Yea, those of old and those of later times,
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "(Yes) verily, those of old, and those of later times.

trs.20: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
trs.85: will all be gathered on a predetermined Day
trs.22: "All will certainly be gathered together for the meeting appointed for a Day well-known.
trs.203: "All will surely be gathered together for appointed Meeting of a known Day.

trs.20: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
trs.85: and you who have gone astray and denied the truth
trs.22: "Then will ye truly,- O ye that go wrong, and treat (Truth) as Falsehood!-
trs.203: "Then moreover, verily you the erring-ones, the deniers (of Resurrection)!

trs.20: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm
trs.85: will eat from the bitter tree of Zaqqum,
trs.22: "Ye will surely taste of the Tree of Zaqqum.
trs.203: "You verily will eat of the trees of Zaqqûm.

trs.20: And filling with it your bellies
trs.85: filling your bellies with it,
trs.22: "Then will ye fill your insides therewith,
trs.203: "Then you will fill your bellies therewith,

trs.20: And drinking on top of it from scalding water.
trs.85: and drink scalding water,
trs.22: "And drink Boiling Water on top of it:
trs.203: "And drink boiling water on top of it.

trs.20: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
trs.85: lapping it like thirsty camels.’
trs.22: "Indeed ye shall drink like diseased camels raging with thirst!"
trs.203: "And you will drink (that) like thirsty camels!"

trs.20: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
trs.85: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgement.
trs.22: Such will be their entertainment on the Day of Requital!
trs.203: That will be their entertainment on the Day of Recompense!

trs.20: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
trs.85: It was We who created you: will you not believe?
trs.22: It is We Who have created you: why will ye not witness the Truth?
trs.203: We created you: then why do you believe not?

trs.20: Have you seen that which you emit?<sup foot_note=197487>1</sup>
trs.85: Consider [the semen] you eject-
trs.22: Do ye then see?- The (human Seed) that ye throw out,-
trs.203: Then tell Me (about) the (human) semen that you emit.

trs.20: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
trs.85: do you create it yourselves or are We the Creator?
trs.22: Is it ye who create it, or are We the Creators?
trs.203: Is it you who create it (i.e. make this semen into a perfect human being), or are We the Creator?

verses.text_uthmani: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

trs.20: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
trs.85: We ordained death to be among you. Nothing could stop Us
trs.22: We have decreed Death to be your common lot, and We are not to be frustrated
trs.203: We have decreed death to you all, and We are not outstripped,

verses.text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَـٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.<sup foot_note=197488>1</sup>
trs.85: if We intended to change you and recreate you in a way unknown to you.
trs.22: from changing your Forms and creating you (again) in (forms) that ye know not.
trs.203: To transfigure you and create you in (forms) that you know not.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

trs.20: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
trs.85: You have learned how you were first created: will you not reflect?
trs.22: And ye certainly know already the first form of creation: why then do ye not celebrate His praises?
trs.203: And indeed, you have already known the first form of creation (i.e. the creation of Adam): why then do you not remember (or take heed)?

trs.20: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
trs.85: Consider the seeds you sow in the ground-
trs.22: See ye the seed that ye sow in the ground?
trs.203: Then tell Me about the seed that you sow in the ground.

trs.20: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
trs.85: is it you who make them grow or We?
trs.22: Is it ye that cause it to grow, or are We the Cause?
trs.203: Is it you that make it grow, or are We the Grower?

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ حُطَـٰمًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ

trs.20: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,<sup foot_note=197489>1</sup>
trs.85: If We wished, We could turn your harvest into chaff and leave you to wail,
trs.22: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry powder, and ye would be left in wonderment,
trs.203: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry pieces, and you would be regretful (or left in wonderment) [Tafsir Ibn Kathîr].

trs.20: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
trs.85: ‘We are burdened with debt;
trs.22: (Saying), "We are indeed left with debts (for nothing):
trs.203: (Saying): "We are indeed Mughramûn (i.e. ruined or have lost the money without any profit, or are punished by the loss of all that we spend for cultivation)! (Tafsir Al-Qurtubî)

trs.20: Rather, we have been deprived."
trs.85: we are bereft.’
trs.22: "Indeed are we shut out (of the fruits of our labour)"
trs.203: "Nay, but we are deprived!"

trs.20: And have you seen the water that you drink?
trs.85: Consider the water you drink-
trs.22: See ye the water which ye drink?
trs.203: Then tell Me about the water that you drink.

verses.text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ

trs.20: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
trs.85: was it you who brought it down from the rain-cloud or We?
trs.22: Do ye bring it down (in rain) from the cloud or do We?
trs.203: Is it you who cause it from the rain-clouds to come down, or are We the Causer of it to come down?

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ

trs.20: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
trs.85: If We wanted, We could make it bitter: will you not be thankful?
trs.22: Were it Our Will, We could make it salt (and unpalatable): then why do ye not give thanks?
trs.203: If We willed, We verily could make it salt (and undrinkable): why then do you not give thanks (to Allâh)?

translation.text: then why are you not grateful
then why are you not grateful

trs.20: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
trs.85: Consider the fire you kindle-
trs.22: See ye the Fire which ye kindle?
trs.203: Then tell Me about the fire which you kindle.

verses.text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ

trs.20: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
trs.85: is it you who make the wood for it grow or We?
trs.22: Is it ye who grow the tree which feeds the fire, or do We grow it?
trs.203: Is it you who made the tree thereof to grow, or are We the Grower?

trs.20: We have made it a reminder<sup foot_note=197491>1</sup> and provision for the travelers,<sup foot_note=197490>2</sup>
trs.85: We made it a reminder, and useful to those who kindle it,
trs.22: We have made it a memorial (of Our handiwork), and an article of comfort and convenience for the denizens of deserts.
trs.203: We have made it a Reminder (of the Hell-fire in the Hereafter), and an article of use for the travellers (and all the others, in this world).

translation.text: for the wayfarers in the desert

trs.20: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
trs.85: so [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Supreme.
trs.22: Then celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme!
trs.203: Then glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

trs.20: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,<sup foot_note=197492>1</sup>
trs.85: I swear by the positions of the stars-
trs.22: Furthermore I call to witness the setting of the Stars,-
trs.203: So I swear by the setting of the stars.<sup foot_note=154962>1</sup>

trs.20: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
trs.85: a mighty oath, if you only knew-
trs.22: And that is indeed a mighty adjuration if ye but knew,-
trs.203: And verily that is indeed a great oath, if you but know.

trs.20: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.
trs.85: that this is truly a noble Quran,
trs.22: That this is indeed a qur'an Most Honourable,
trs.203: That (this) is indeed an honourable recitation (the Noble Qur’ân).

trs.20: In a Register well-protected;<sup foot_note=197493>1</sup>.
trs.85: in a protected Record
trs.22: In Book well-guarded,
trs.203: In a Book well-guarded (with Allâh in the heaven i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz ).

trs.20: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].
trs.85: that only the purified can touch,
trs.22: Which none shall touch but those who are clean:
trs.203: Which (that Book with Allâh) none can touch but the purified (i.e. the angels).

trs.20: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
trs.85: sent down from the Lord of all being.
trs.22: A Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
trs.203: A Revelation (this Qur’ân) from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

trs.20: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
trs.85: How can you scorn this statement?
trs.22: Is it such a Message that ye would hold in light esteem?
trs.203: Is it such a talk (this Qur’ân) that you (disbelievers) deny?

trs.20: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
trs.85: And how, in return for the livelihood you are given, can you deny it?
trs.22: And have ye made it your livelihood that ye should declare it false?
trs.203: And instead (of thanking Allâh) for the provision He gives you, you deny (Him by disbelief)!

trs.20: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat
trs.85: When the soul of a dying man comes up to his throat
trs.22: Then why do ye not (intervene) when (the soul of the dying man) reaches the throat,-
trs.203: Then why do you not (intervene) when (the soul of a dying person) reaches the throat?

trs.20: And you are at that time looking on -
trs.85: while you gaze on-
trs.22: And ye the while (sit) looking on,-
trs.203: And you at the moment are looking on,

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ

trs.20: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
trs.85: We are nearer to him than you, though you do not see Us-
trs.22: But We are nearer to him than ye, and yet see not,-
trs.203: But We (i.e. Our angels who take the soul) are nearer to him than you, but you see not, (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

trs.20: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
trs.85: why, if you are not to be judged,
trs.22: Then why do ye not,- If you are exempt from (future) account,-
trs.203: Then why do you not - if you are exempt from the reckoning and recompense (punishment) -

trs.20: Bring it back,<sup foot_note=197494>1</sup> if you should be truthful?
trs.85: do you not restore his soul to him, if what you say is true?
trs.22: Call back the soul, if ye are true (in the claim of independence)?
trs.203: Bring back the soul (to its body), if you are truthful?

trs.20: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to Allāh],
trs.85: If that dying person is one of those who will be brought near to God,
trs.22: Thus, then, if he be of those Nearest to Allah,
trs.203: Then, if he (the dying person) be of the Muqarrabûn (those brought near to Allâh),

trs.20: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
trs.85: he will have rest, ease, and a Garden of Bliss;
trs.22: (There is for him) Rest and Satisfaction, and a Garden of Delights.
trs.203: (There is for him) rest and provision, and a Garden of Delights (Paradise).

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

trs.20: And if he was of the companions of the right,
trs.85: if he is one of those on the Right,
trs.22: And if he be of the Companions of the Right Hand,
trs.203: And if he (the dying person) be of those on the Right Hand,

trs.20: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
trs.85: [he will hear], ‘Peace be on you,’ from his companions on the Right;
trs.22: (For him is the salutation), "Peace be unto thee", from the Companions of the Right Hand.
trs.203: Then there is safety and peace (from the Punishment of Allâh) for those on the right Hand.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

trs.20: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
trs.85: but if he is one of those who denied the truth and went astray,
trs.22: And if he be of those who treat (Truth) as Falsehood, who go wrong,
trs.203: But if he (the dying person) be of the denying (of the Resurrection), the erring (away from the Right Path of Islâmic Monotheism),

trs.20: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
trs.85: he will be welcomed with scalding water.
trs.22: For him is Entertainment with Boiling Water.
trs.203: Then for him is an entertainment with boiling water.

trs.20: And burning in Hellfire.
trs.85: He will burn in Hell.
trs.22: And burning in Hell-Fire.
trs.203: And burning in Hell-fire.

trs.20: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
trs.85: This is the certain truth:
trs.22: Verily, this is the Very Truth and Certainly.
trs.203: Verily, this! This is an absolute Truth with certainty.

trs.20: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
trs.85: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Supreme.
trs.22: So celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme.
trs.203: So glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
